description: Retry the current saved stock policy for a channel or optional productId, without changing the rule or arming any direction. Read get_channel_stock_limit first, copy its current retryToken verbatim, and show its delivery/readiness reasons; disabled inventory writes stay disabled. Requires settings:write and the owner's AI marketplace-writes switch. Queues up to 500 eligible products; remaining products use scheduled reconciliation. A queued job is not marketplace acceptance. Confirm with the person first. Echoes the workspace.

retryToken.description: Copy the current retryToken from get_channel_stock_limit for the same workspace, platform and optional productId. Expires in 15 minutes.

name: retry_channel_stock_delivery
